core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aashir represents Arabic عاشر (ʿāshir), meaning tenth or tenth in sequence; the name's exact use should not be confused with the separate verb form عاشرَ.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Arabic عاشر (ʿāshir) can mean “tenth” as an ordinal. The previous explanation incorrectly linked it to “one who associates with” while deriving it from عَشَرَ (“to take a tenth”); those claims do not align. The distinct form عاشَرَ can mean to associate or live with, but that does not establish the same meaning for عاشر. Personal-name usage requires separate evidence.
